products.name: Nivis Labs Foot Cream
products.subtitle: Nivis Labs Foot Cream is specially formulated to transform dry, rough, and cracked feet into soft, smooth skin. Enriched with powerful exfoliaters like Urea and Salicylic Acid, it deeply moisturizes and gently sheds dead skin cells. The soothing infusion of Neem provides natural antibacterial protection, while Lavender Oil offers a relaxing aroma and restores moisture balance. Perfect for daily foot care routines to keep your feet hydrated, healthy, and crack-free.
